0022600004.text: Both the Minnesota Timberwolves and the Miami Heat are opening their 2026-27 seasons, with the Timberwolves visiting Miami. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-0 in Minnesota's favor, and the most recent meeting, on January 6, 2026 in Minneapolis, ended with the Timberwolves winning 122-94. Minnesota will be without Donte DiVincenzo, who is out after Achilles surgery, and Rocco Zikarsky is listed as day-to-day for an undisclosed reason. Miami's Bam Adebayo, Dru Smith and Pelle Larsson are all listed as day-to-day, with Adebayo dealing with a groin injury, Smith with a calf strain and Larsson with an illness.
